hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap implements a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults as a Uniswap v4 hook. It intercepts swaps via beforeSwap, computes quotes against an internal reserve curve, and settles trades by depositing input tokens into and withdrawing output tokens from Euler vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to fully bypass standard pool math.
